title: Early Childhood Educator Pay Equity Fund data

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the DC Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Information related to applicants for the Early Childhood Educator Pay Equity Fund in Washington, DC. Specifically, I am requesting the following at the provider-applicant level, as it is available:

1. Provider facility name
2. Provider license number
3. Provider type (e.g., center, home, Head Start, pre-K, etc.)
4. Physical street number
5. Physical street name
6. Physical city
7. Physical zip code
8. Application date, separately for each application, if applicable
9. Application decision date, separately for each application, if applicable
10. Application outcome (e.g., approved, waitlisted, denied), separately for each application, if applicable
11. Award amount if approved, separately for each quarter that payment was received

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Gabrielle Pepin

title: Fox Request #2 (Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

VA's regulations (38 CFR 78.50(c)) allow Fox grantees to provide non-emergency mental and behavioral health services to eligible individuals, provided the grantee bears the cost. Please answer the following:
1.	How does VA verify that grant funds are not paying for these services?
2.	Please provide any records, such as a spreadsheet or log, of inquiries VA has made to grantees over the past three years to confirm that these services were delivered at the grantee's expense.
3.	In the past three years, how many times have grantees billed the Veterans Community Care Program for non-emergency services provided to Fox participants?
The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes. In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jasper Craven

title: Fox Request #1 (Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

A VA press release earlier this year stated that Fox program data “show that more than 90% of participants who complete services report improvements in one or more of the following areas: suicidal ideation, overall well-being, mental health status, social support or financial stability; helping to strengthen protective factors and reduce drivers of suicide risk.

Can you please provide the numerator and denominator, and the relevant time period, for which the 90% figure was derived.  Please break that down separately into suicidal ideation, overall well-being, mental health status, social support or financial stability. Please also indicate the number of Fox participates who exited the program during the period in question for whom there are no metric scores.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jasper Craven

title: Hannon Act #2 (Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

The 2020 Hannon Act lays out a system for grantee renewals that is based three factors: 
1.	 the success of a grantee's program, 
2.	 the cost-effectiveness of a grantee's program,
3.	 the extent to which the grantee's program complies with SSG Fox SPGP goals and requirements.
Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records: the scoring sheets for each of the grantees applying for initial award and for award renewal for FY27.
Please also provide the exact criteria that VA applies for “cost-effectiveness” that accounts for 20 percent of the scoring.
Please also provide any (deidentified) correspondence to awardees who were not performing required baseline screening of all eligible individuals.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jasper Craven

title: Hannon Act #1 (Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

The 2020 Hannon Act requires VA to submit an annual report on the Fox Grant program.

I hereby request the following records: a copy of the 2026 report. (For reference, I can attach a copy of the 2025 report, which includes data up until March of 2025. Just let me know.)

If such a report does not exist, I am requesting a copy of raw data that was tabulated on the Fox Grant Program, including:

•	The total number of (a) veterans, (b) service members and (c) family members who entered the Fox Grant Program in 2025
•	The total number of (a) veterans, (b) service members and (c) family members who entered the Fox Grant Program and for whom an entry baseline mental health assessment was conducted in 2025.
•	The total number of individuals who were in the program on January 1, 2025.
•	The total number of individuals who were in the program on December 31, 2025.
•	The total number of individuals who exited the program during the calendar year.
•	The total number of individuals who exited the program during the calendar year and for whom a mental health assessment was conducted and data forwarded to the VA.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jasper Craven

title: Public-records request — OCR case 02-22-1153 monitoring records (Jan. 1, 2025–present)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New Jersey Open Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide electronic copies of records maintained by PLUMSTED TOWNSHIP SCHOOL DISTRICT from January 1, 2025 through the date of this request concerning the U.S. Department of Education, Office for Civil Rights (OCR) resolution agreement in OCR case 02-22-1153.

I request the following existing records:

1. District correspondence with OCR about the identified agreement or case, including messages to or from OCR-Transition@ed.gov, the OCR staff addresses identified in the Agreement or Letter, and other Department of Education addresses ending in @ed.gov when the message concerns this case, agreement, or a related monitoring submission. This includes OCR acknowledgments, feedback, approvals, requests for revision or additional information, closure-related messages, and any bounced, undeliverable, rejected, failed-delivery, out-of-office, automated-reply, non-delivery, or other delivery-status messages, as well as follow-up messages or internal records indicating that an attempted OCR contact or submission did not receive a response. Include attachments and transmittal emails.
2. Records submitted, prepared for submission, or maintained for submission to OCR, including reports, data, policies, training materials, remediation records, implementation updates, requests for approval, transmittal emails, and records identifying deliverables, deadlines, or responsible staff.
3. Internal district emails or memoranda about an inability to reach OCR, delivery failures, unacknowledged submissions, unanswered follow-ups, delayed OCR feedback or approval, delayed submission, or delayed agreement work.

If no responsive records exist, please state that explicitly. If any portion is withheld, please identify the specific exemption and release all reasonably segregable portions.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Meredith Kolodner

communications.subject: DC Freedom of Information Act Request: Secondhand Smoke Request in DC
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the DC Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request records from January 1, 2020, through October 13, 2026, documenting complaints of secondhand smoke entering residential units from other units or areas of multifamily residential buildings in Washington, D.C. Please provide existing complaint logs or databases, including complaint dates, general locations or ward, complaint category, agency response, inspection findings, referrals, and case outcomes, where those fields are maintained. Please also include records showing the number of complaints received, if such records already exist. Please redact personal identifying information as necessary and provide the remaining nonexempt information electronically, preferably in spreadsheet format where available. If your agency does not maintain these records, please let me know if another agency is likely to maintain them. I am willing to narrow the request if needed.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lyneka Little
